notes.title: Limsod Demo available now!
notes.content:
Get ready soldier!

Limsod Demo is now available for free on Steam!

Take now your basic equipment and save the regions of the world affected by the virus that has turned the population into zombies.

[previewyoutube=PwdoK_NqQpg;full][/previewyoutube]

In this demo you will have:

The basis of the game
Access to Survival game mode and 2 related maps (Agency and Arcade)
Access to Death Sleeves game mode and 1 related map (Office)

Buy the full game to unlock:

Over 35 unique maps.
10 different game modes.
More than 80 quests and objectives.
12 weapon upgrades.
61 achievements.
More than 50 cosmetics.
And much much more!

notes.title: Limsod v1.3.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are very excited to present the third content update for Limsod!
In this update, mainly the switch to one of the latest versions of the unreal engine (which changes a lot of things inside the game). Also a new map for the Unlimited game mode, as well as new quests and achievements, improved quality of life and many other little things!

Also, a demo of Limsod will be available for free on Steam!

Here is a detailed list of what we have been working on:


  Switch to unreal engine 5.4, which means:

Several texture enhancements
Improved zombie AIs
Improved LODs
Improved lightings
Improved shadows
Optimization of light sources
Performance stabilization


  Additions:

Added map for Unlimited game mode: Cargo
Added interactive objects on all maps
Added seasonal events
Added total controller support
Added discord rich presence
Added a button to skip the tutorial
Added a button for replaying the tutorial (in the game mode menu)
Added 3 new achievements
Added 3 new normal quests (use 25, 75, 150 grenades)
Added a new ambience sound for explosive zombie
Added new lights in the room at the back of the Training game mode map
Added 6 new icons


  Changes:

Modification of crosshair
Modification of several menu visuals
Modification of the Steam link in the pause menu
Modification of controller icons
Modification of the information menu
Modification of the legal menu


  Corrections:

Fixed of random background musics in-game
Fixed timer that did not start with game modes: Time Saving, Melee, Custom
Fixed player sprint speed
Fixed the player custom sprint speed (with Custom game mode)
Fixed zombies that were already spawned on the jungle map (Defense game mode)
Fixed zombies in Defense game mode that didn't move.
Fixed zombie trajectory on Defense game mode maps
Fixed several translation problems

notes.title: Limsod v1.1.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are very excited to present the first major content update for Limsod!
This first content update focuses mainly on the game's maps.

We've added 5 new maps for the main game modes (Survival, Points Race, Time Saving, Melee, Preview, Custom):

Arcade
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774217/20f69d09bb783568698603f53df1889beec5bab8.png

Cargo
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774217/1f287a6c586e3ea1299b284c19569416e73f110a.png

Office
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774217/925e4539f3a219b90e342dead725a4239fa75b2f.png

Parking
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774217/9d00f2db07f968b5ff372f79cedc9b5528db12c9.png

Warehouse
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774217/cd780b24af647c5d369c736ceaf999d1cc5f5d35.png

But we've also added new maps to game modes that previously had only one:
 
Unlimited game mode which now owns the maps: Labyrinth, Jungle, Mountain, Dry Mountain, Dark Forest (in addition to the existing City map)
Defense game mode which now owns the maps: City, Cargo, Labyrinth, Parking, Warehouse (in addition to the existing Jungle map)
Death Sleeves game mode which now owns the maps: Agency, Arcade, Bank, Office (in addition to the existing Laboratory map)

We hope you enjoy this first content update!


Here is a detailed list of what we have been working on:

  Additions:
